nameOrigin: young feeding stage of an insect

pokedexEntries.bk: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

pokedexEntries.wh: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

pokedexEntries.x: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

pokedexEntries.or: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

pokedexEntries.y: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

pokedexEntries.as: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

pokedexEntries.us: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.um: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.

pokedexEntries.sw: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.

pokedexEntries.sh: Larvesta’s body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.
